description: This file defines the AWS DirectConnect client class, including method signatures for interacting with AWS Direct Connect services, and extends the AwsClient class.

classes.name: DirectConnectClient
classes.description: A client class for AWS Direct Connect service, providing methods to interact with the service.

methods.name: acceptDirectConnectGatewayAssociationProposal
methods.description: Accepts a Direct Connect Gateway association proposal.

methods.name: allocateConnectionOnInterconnect
methods.description: Allocates a connection on an interconnect.

methods.name: associateConnectionWithLag
methods.description: Associates a connection with a LAG.

methods.name: createDirectConnectGatewayAssociation
methods.description: Creates an association between a Direct Connect Gateway and a virtual interface.

methods.name: createDirectConnectGatewayAssociationProposal
methods.description: Creates a proposal for associating a Direct Connect Gateway.

methods.name: deleteDirectConnectGatewayAssociation
methods.description: Deletes an association between a Direct Connect Gateway and a virtual interface.

methods.name: deleteDirectConnectGatewayAssociationProposal
methods.description: Deletes a proposal for associating a Direct Connect Gateway.

methods.name: describeConnectionLoa
methods.description: Describes the LOA (Letter of Authorization) for a connection.

methods.name: describeDirectConnectGatewayAssociationProposals
methods.description: Describes proposals for associating Direct Connect Gateways.

methods.name: describeDirectConnectGatewayAssociations
methods.description: Describes associations between Direct Connect Gateways and virtual interfaces.

methods.name: describeDirectConnectGatewayAttachments
methods.description: Describes attachments of Direct Connect Gateways.

methods.name: describeInterconnectLoa
methods.description: Describes the LOA for an interconnect.

methods.name: disassociateConnectionFromLag
methods.description: Disassociates a connection from a LAG.

methods.name: updateDirectConnectGatewayAssociation
methods.description: Updates an association between a Direct Connect Gateway and a virtual interface.

methods.name: updateVirtualInterfaceAttributes
methods.description: Updates attributes of a virtual interface.
